about_the_game:
Strikers Club is your ultimate multiplayer football simulation game where you take control of a player and compete in action-packed matches against others. Master dribbling, passing, and shooting while working with your team to outplay opponents. With gameplay that rewards precision and timing, every move counts, delivering a fast-paced, skill-driven experience that keeps you engaged until the final whistle.

Free-to-play

Strikers Club is free-to-play and always will be. Cosmetic elements and additional features are available for purchase and obtainable through gameplay and events.

We don't do pay-to-win, because pay-to-win sucks.

Multiplayer

Every player on the field is a real person. Work together to win your association football match using dribbling, shooting, skill moves and other mechanics.

Skill-based gameplay

There is no luck or randomness factor involved in Strikers Club. The better team will win by having better team-play and individual skill.

Real football

Strikers Club implements all of the game rules. Throw-ins, corners, penalties, fouls, and numerous other elements that make the game loyal to the sport.

Choose your position

The game's name may be Strikers Club, but every position is represented in the game. Choose which one you prefer playing at the start of the match. If you play as a goalie, you have an extra set of mechanics to make the difference. You can even run up to participate in plays up the field!

SEE YOU ON THE FIELD!
